packageRules.description: [automerge] Starlette is imported by runtime code (lso/auth.py, lso/oidc.py) although it is declared only in the dev group, so a dev-group bump must be reviewed
[disable] redis-py must stay below 6.5: kombu does not notice redis-py >= 8 dropping the broker socket, so workers stay deaf after a reconnect. See the pin and its comment in pyproject.toml
[cooldown] nwa-stdlib is our own package and exempt from the uv cooldown, so it is exempt from Renovate's release age too. Keep in sync with exclude-newer-package in pyproject.toml

[cooldown] certifi is exempt from the uv cooldown so CA-distrust advisories land immediately, so it is exempt from Renovate's release age too. Keep in sync with exclude-newer-package in pyproject.toml

[disable] The example image must stay on a Python that requires-python supports (>=3.12,<3.15). Only python:3.13-alpine is extracted from Dockerfile.example; it is disabled instead of constrained so Renovate never edits major/minor/patch of the image tag
